text:
## Documentation & Record Retention  
### Required Records  
For each customer:
- Copy of identity document
- Copy of address verification document
- KYC verification record (date, method, approver)
- Risk assessment (if high-risk)
- PEP screening result
- Adverse media screening result
- AML screening result  
**Storage Location:** Secure document management system (DMS-001)
**Access Control:** Role-based (Compliance staff only)
**Audit Trail:** All access logged
**Retention:** 6 years post-account closure (see [[policy_retention]])

raw_entities.description: Policy governing the collection, storage, access control, and retention of customer identity, verification, risk assessment, and screening records. raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement to collect and retain a copy of each customer's address verification document as part of KYC documentation obligations.

raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement to maintain a KYC verification record documenting the date, method, and approver for each customer verification performed.

raw_entities.name: Role-Based Access Control for Records
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement to implement role-based access control restricting access to customer records to Compliance staff only.

raw_entities.name: Audit Trail Logging for Record Access
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement to maintain comprehensive audit logging of all access to customer records stored in the document management system.

raw_entities.name: Record Retention Period of Six Years Post-Account Closure
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement to retain all customer documentation and records for a minimum of 6 years following the closure of the customer's account.

raw_entities.name: Secure Document Management System
raw_entities.description: Designated secure system (DMS-001) for centralized storage of all customer documentation, identity records, verification documents, and screening results with built-in access controls and audit logging capabilities.
context: Storage Location: Secure document management system (DMS-001)

raw_entities.name: Role-Based Access Control System
raw_entities.description: Access control mechanism restricting document retrieval and viewing permissions to Compliance staff only, preventing unauthorized access to sensitive customer records.

raw_entities.name: Access Audit Logging
raw_entities.description: Automated logging mechanism that records all access events to customer records, enabling detection and investigation of unauthorized or suspicious access patterns.

raw_entities.name: Compliance Staff
raw_entities.description: Staff members with designated responsibility for accessing, managing, and maintaining customer documentation and records within the secure document management system. Only Compliance staff are authorized to access stored records.

raw_entities.name: Identity Document
raw_entities.description: Official identity document required to be collected and retained as part of KYC verification procedures for each customer. A copy must be stored in the secure document management system.

raw_entities.name: Address Verification Document
raw_entities.description: Document required to verify customer address as part of KYC procedures. A copy must be collected and retained in the secure document management system.

raw_entities.name: KYC Verification Record
raw_entities.description: Documented record of customer identity verification including the date of verification, the method used, and the staff member or system that approved the verification. Must be retained for 6 years post-account closure.

raw_entities.name: PEP Screening
raw_entities.description: Screening process to identify whether customers are classified as Politically Exposed Persons. Results must be documented and retained for 6 years post-account closure.

raw_entities.name: Adverse Media Screening
raw_entities.description: Screening process to identify adverse media coverage or negative information associated with customers. Results must be documented and retained for 6 years post-account closure.

raw_entities.name: AML Screening
raw_entities.description: Screening process to identify customers against sanctions lists and AML watchlists. Results must be documented and retained for 6 years post-account closure.

raw_entities.name: High-Risk Customer Classification
raw_entities.description: Risk category identifying customers assessed as high-risk, requiring enhanced due diligence and documented risk assessment records to be retained for 6 years post-account closure.
